subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the open conflicting fork PR for this issue, or close/supersede it and permit a new narrow same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open fork PR already uses closing syntax and the issue is marked no-new-fix-pr, so automation should not create another fix branch until maintainers choose the canonical repair path.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused same-repo fix that covers both custom-prompt mutation and the transcript-marker model boundary.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase it, add real behavior proof, and expand coverage if the transcript-marker boundary remains in scope.

options.title: Pause For Owner Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair automation until the heartbeat prompt-boundary owner decides the exact fix shape.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused same-repo fix that covers both custom-prompt mutation and the transcript-marker model boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the related path-hint behavior and authored the first same-repo fix attempt, making it the strongest available routing signal for the maintainer choice.
